# Green European Journal

> > Green European Journal is Europe's leading platform for green political thought, covering climate policy, the Green Deal, post-growth economics, and progressive movements across the continent.

The journal publishes multilingual analysis and commentary on environmental politics, social justice, and democratic transformation. It features contributions from activists, academics, and policymakers examining Europe's ecological and political challenges through a green lens.

## Key Topics

- Green Deal
- post-growth economics
- climate policy
- green transition
- ecofeminism
- democracy and authoritarianism
- sustainable housing
- just transition
- municipalism and grassroots movements
- nuclear energy debate
- academic freedom
- gender and far-right politics
- urban climate adaptation
- solidarity and social justice
- European progressive politics

## Climate Policy and the Green Deal

- [Affordable Sustainable Housing Can Bring the Green Deal Home](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/affordable-sustainable-housing-can-bring-the-green-deal-home): Green Deal housing policies for sustainable, affordable European homes
- [Τα��ινομία της Ε.Ε.: Η βρώμικη πολιτική του πράσινου ξεπλύματος της ενέργειας](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/%cf%84%ce%b1%ce%be%ce%b9%ce%bd%ce%bf%ce%bc%ce%af%ce%b1-%cf%84%ce%b7%cf%82-%ce%b5-%ce%b5-%ce%b7-%ce%b2%cf%81%cf%8e%ce%bc%ce%b9%ce%ba%ce%ae-%cf%80%ce%bf%ce%bb%ce%b9%cf%84%ce%b9%ce%ba%ce%ae-%cf%84): EU taxonomy greenwashing gas & nuclear energy (Greek)
- [The Cities Feeling the Heat](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/the-cities-feeling-the-heat): Urban heat & climate adaptation in European cities
- [Πυρηνική ενέργεια: Και πάλι υπό εξέταση;](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/%cf%80%cf%85%cf%81%ce%b7%ce%bd%ce%b9%ce%ba%ce%ae-%ce%b5%ce%bd%ce%ad%cf%81%ce%b3%ce%b5%ce%b9%ce%b1-%ce%ba%ce%b1%ce%b9-%cf%80%ce%ac%ce%bb%ce%b9-%cf%85%cf%80%cf%8c-%ce%b5%ce%be%ce%ad%cf%84%ce%b1%cf%83): Nuclear energy debate in European climate policy (Greek)
- [Зошто не треба да се патува со авион](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/%d0%b7%d0%be%d1%88%d1%82%d0%be-%d0%bd%d0%b5-%d1%82%d1%80%d0%b5%d0%b1%d0%b0-%d0%b4%d0%b0-%d1%81%d0%b5-%d0%bf%d0%b0%d1%82%d1%83%d0%b2%d0%b0-%d1%81%d0%be-%d0%b0%d0%b2%d0%b8%d0%be%d0%bd): Aviation climate policy & sustainable travel (Macedonian)
- [How We Put Out the Fire](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/how-we-put-out-the-fire): Kim Stanley Robinson's Ministry for the Future & climate action

## Post-Growth Economics and Social Justice

- [The Politics of Post-Growth](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/the-politics-of-post-growth): Post-growth economics debate with Kallis at European Parliament
- [En busca de una economía europea con los pies en la tierra](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/en-busca-de-una-economia-europea-con-los-pies-en-la-tierra): Post-growth economics & inequality with Gentiloni & Lamberts (Spanish)
- [Solidarity in an Age of Shocks](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/solidarity-in-an-age-of-shocks): Cost-of-living crisis & Europe's socio-economic model rebalancing
- [La solidarietà in tempo di crisi](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/la-solidarieta-in-tempo-di-crisi): Cost-of-living crisis & European socio-economic rebalancing (Italian)
- [Sprawiedliwa transformacja polega na zmianie systemowej](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/sprawiedliwa-transformacja-polega-na-zmianie-systemowej): Just transition as systemic change with Dirk Holemans (Polish)

## Grassroots Movements and Municipalism

- [From Grassroots to Government: Greens Leading Reform in Zagreb](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/from-grassroots-to-government-greens-leading-reform-in-zagreb): Zagreb's Green municipalist movement leading Balkan progressive wave
- [Progressive Forces in Budapest Navigating a Hostile Climate](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/fighting-orbanism-in-budapest): Progressive movements resisting Orbán's authoritarianism in Budapest
- [Ne Davimo Beograd: A Shapeshifting Movement](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/a-shapeshifting-movement): Ne Davimo Beograd's grassroots activism in Serbian politics
- [Doświadczenie bezsilności zmienia wszystko](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/doswiadczenie-bezsilnosci-zmienia-wszystko): Belarus-Russia alliance & mass protests ft. Vincent Bevins (Polish)

## Feminism, Gender, and Democracy

- [Françoise d'Eaubonne and the Imperfect Foundation of Ecofeminist Thought](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/francoise-deaubonne-and-the-imperfect-foundation-of-ecofeminist-thought): Françoise d'Eaubonne's 1974 ecofeminist theory linking nature & women
- [Jak płeć stała się kluczowa dla polityki skrajnej prawicy](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/jak-plec-stala-sie-kluczowa-dla-polityki-skrajnej-prawicy): Gender studies' role in far-right politics (Polish)
- [Wywrotowe zajęcia. Wojna o europejskie szkolnictwo wyższe](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/wywrotowe-zajecia-wojna-o-europejskie-szkolnictwo-wyzsze): Academic freedom under attack in European higher education (Polish)

## Education and Work

- [Reimaging Education to Transform How We Work, Learn and Play](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/transforming-work-reimagining-education): Lifelong learning & education reform for equality & green jobs
